title: 18 Restaurant Facebook Ads Examples To Pump Up Revenue

facts.fact: The article presents 18 examples of restaurant Facebook ads.
facts.quote: 18 Restaurant Facebook Ads Examples To Pump Up Revenue

facts.fact: The Seahorse Restaurant Facebook ad offers a chance to win a $50 gift card through a giveaway.
facts.quote: The ad offers a chance to win a $50 gift card, enticing potential customers with a free reward.

facts.fact: The BJ's Restaurant & Brewhouse Facebook ad promotes '10 Bone-In Wings for $10' as part of its '$10 Wing Wednesday' offer.
The Broken Yolk Cafe Facebook ad, as described by Restaurant Growth, emphasizes the cafe's success with 34 locations.
According to Restaurant Growth's own claim, the agency has helped over 2,800 restaurants.
facts.quote: Our team has helped over 2,800 restaurants boost their profit margins

facts.fact: According to Restaurant Growth's own claim, its clients' profit margins rose by an average of 18% in just 90 days.
facts.quote: boost their profit margins by an average of 18% in just 90 days.
